CheckRules.description_en: Checks data protection scoring rules. Calling this operation triggers an asynchronous task to check whether your resources meet the data protection scoring requirements
CheckRules.description_zh: 检查数据保护评分规则，调用该接口将会触发一个异步任务来检查您的资源是否满足数据保护评分的要求

CloseBdrcService.description_en: Shuts down the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center

DescribeCheckDetails.description_en: Retrieves the check results for data protection rules
DescribeCheckDetails.description_zh: 查询数据保护规则检查结果

DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.description_en: Queries statistics on data redundancy types for a cloud service
DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.description_zh: 查询云产品数据冗余类型统计信息

DescribeProducts.description_en: Queries the data protection score status of cloud services
DescribeProducts.description_zh: 查询云产品的数据保护评分状态

DescribeRules.description_en: Queries a list of data protection rules
DescribeRules.description_zh: 查询数据保护规则列表

DescribeTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of an asynchronous task

DescribeTopRiskyResources.description_zh: 查询风险最多的资源列表

DisableCheckProduct.description_en: Disables the data protection score for a cloud service
DisableCheckProduct.description_zh: 关闭云产品的数据保护评分

DisableCheckResource.description_en: Disables the data protection score for a resource
DisableCheckResource.description_zh: 关闭资源的数据保护评分

EnableCheckProduct.description_en: Enables data protection scoring for an Alibaba Cloud service
EnableCheckProduct.description_zh: 开启云产品数据保护评分

EnableCheckResource.description_en: Enables data protection scoring for a single resource
EnableCheckResource.description_zh: 开启单个资源的数据保护评分

GetBdrcService.description_en: Queries the status of the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center
GetBdrcService.description_zh: 查询数据灾备中心状态

ListProtectionPolicies.description_en: Retrieves a list of protection policies

ListProtectionPolicyApplications.description_en: Retrieves the application history of the protection policy
ListProtectionPolicyApplications.description_zh: 获取保护策略应用历史

ListResourceCategories.description_en: Retrieves a list of resource categories

OpenBdrcService.description_en: Enables the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center

UpdateResources.description_en: Updates the resource list. When you call this operation, an asynchronous task is triggered to update your resource list and data protection score
UpdateResources.description_zh: 更新资源列表。调用该接口后，将会触发一个异步任务来更新您的资源列表和数据保护评分
